stakes.why: X says maybe (the speaker is misattributed) and Y says no (the legal substance is untouched); both are defensible for a moved thank-you.

rank.why: Parakeet and Qwen3 have nothing at the spot; Whisper adds 'Thank you'. X: Parakeet 1, Qwen3 1, Whisper 2. Y ranks Whisper first for 'including Kagan's interjection' and Parakeet last, which is backwards.

overall.why: X gets the whole-transcript reading, noticeable, rule and rank right; Y misreads the record and ranks the engines backwards, though Y does better on blind and misses.
